mechanism_narrative: A sustained effective federal funds rate above 5.0% compresses corporate borrowing costs and reduces equity valuation multiples, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in unemployment rate below 4.0% signals accelerating labor market strength and rising consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE falls below 4.0%, SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous acceleration in industrial production and housing starts indicates broad-based economic expansion, increasing corporate earnings growth expectations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO and HOUST both rise above their 3-month moving averages, SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation (CPIAUCSL > 310) and high-unemployment (UNRATE > 4.0%) regimes, market anticipation of delayed monetary easing drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods with CPIAUCSL > 310 and UNRATE > 4.0, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Retail sales growth above 700,000 million dollars signals robust consumer spending, supporting corporate revenue growth and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When RSAFS exceeds 700,000, SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Payroll growth exceeding 0.5% month-over-month indicates strengthening labor market conditions, boosting consumer confidence and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS growth rate exceeds 0.5% MoM, SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production growth above 103.0 indicates expanding manufacturing output, increasing corporate earnings visibility and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO exceeds 103.0, SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In low-inflation (CPIAUCSL < 312) and low-unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%) regimes, prolonged monetary accommodation expectations drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods with CPIAUCSL < 312 and UNRATE < 4.0, SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of cases.
